title: Sawgrass Asset Management LLC Sells 582,436 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Sawgrass Asset Management LLC decreased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 97.5% in the second quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 14,984 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 582,436 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 5.1% of Sawgrass Asset Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest position. Sawgrass Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $113,840,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other hedge funds and have also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Essex Financial Services Inc. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 0.5% during the first quarter. Essex Financial Services Inc. now owns 96,590 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $16,206,000 after purchasing an additional 524 shares during the period. Zeke Capital Advisors LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 17.1% during the first quarter. Zeke Capital Advisors LLC now owns 122,050 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $20,478,000 after purchasing an additional 17,805 shares during the period. Mackay Shields LLC acquired a new stake in shares of Apple during the first quarter worth approximately $332,905,000. Annex Advisory Services LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 2.1% during the first quarter. Annex Advisory Services LLC now owns 28,371 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,760,000 after purchasing an additional 578 shares during the period. Finally, Bronfman E.L. Rothschild L.P. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 2.1% during the first quarter. Bronfman E.L. Rothschild L.P. now owns 95,993 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $16,106,000 after purchasing an additional 1,942 shares during the period. Hedge funds and own 58.44% of the company’s stock.
Get Apple alerts: In related news, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Wednesday, October 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total transaction of $5,816,500.00. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $24,554,471.08. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this hyperlink . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 14,194 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction on Friday, October 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $227.96, for a total transaction of $3,235,664.24. Following the transaction, the senior vice president now directly owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at approximately $24,058,442.48. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders sold 544,185 shares of company stock worth $120,312,613. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Several research firms recently commented on AAPL. BidaskClub cut shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. restated a “buy” rating and set a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 10th. Royal Bank of Canada restated a “buy” rating and set a $240.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, September 11th. Finally, Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty have assigned a hold rating and twenty-eight have given a buy rating to the company. Apple presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average price target of $223.60.
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $201.59 on Tuesday. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $150.24 and a 12 month high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $1,019.79 billion, a PE ratio of 17.48, a PEG ratio of 1.48 and a beta of 1.26. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 EPS for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The company had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $2.07 earnings per share. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 13.48 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, November 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, November 12th will be given a $0.73 dividend. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.45%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Thursday, November 8th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is 24.52%.
